verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a code-first framework distributed as npm ES6/TypeScript modules, so scene logic can live in ordinary source files that work with version control. It also supports glTF and its own .babylon format, and the Playground offers code sharing. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses version-control friendliness, merging, or team workflows. Missing for 10: documented diffable/mergeable scene format, evidence the .babylon or editor outputs are text-diffable, built-in multi-user collaboration, and any hands-on reports of team/VCS workflows.
